critic_decisions.stage07_routing_reconciliation: Stage 7 semantic routing moved ability introductions to better lesson-level homes while preserving Stage-1 capability ownership and the Stage-6 reviewed windows. A capacity guard keeps every lesson at or below the existing ability threshold of 9. The reroute changes raw total counts in U4/U10 and adds one U4-L04 total warning; this is recorded rather than hidden or absorbed by raising thresholds.
critic_decisions.U3-L01: Provisionally retain. Three pronunciation source strands are integrated receptive cues in one extended-listening performance, not three isolated pronunciation teaching blocks. Stage 7 must keep the lesson meaning-focused and Stage 8.5 must re-audit role-aware load.
critic_decisions.U4: Provisionally retain the seven instructional slots. The lexical warnings arise from broad descriptive/process/narrative content homes shared by C08 and later C15; Stage 4 explicitly leaves many lexical records mixed or recognition/support pending Stage 8. They must not become 27-28 independently memorised productive words per lesson. U4-L01's 13 grammar rows are reference/description infrastructure grouped into a small number of systems rather than thirteen separate rules. U4-L04 now also exceeds the raw total threshold after semantic ability rerouting; this remains a provisional raw-row warning and must be reopened if Stage 8 active-role assignment makes the lesson cognitively dense.
critic_decisions.U5-L05: Conditionally retain. The 21 EGP rows cluster inside a bounded set of probability/certainty/expectation/deduction/semi-modal systems serving one communicative outcome. This is the strongest grammar warning and must be reopened if Stage 8 assigns too many rows independent productive-control roles; Stage 8.5 must explicitly test active system load rather than raw row count.
critic_decisions.U5-L06: Retain provisionally. The 13 rows cluster around past possibility/regret/speculation and temporal viewpoint; raw rows exceed the threshold by one and do not imply thirteen teaching objects.
critic_decisions.U6-L04: Retain provisionally. The 15 rows are interpersonal stance/question/politeness resources serving disagreement management; final control roles must prevent a fifteen-rule grammar lesson.
critic_decisions.U10: Conditionally retain. The writing unit carries the largest lexical breadth because C15 is a natural home for many descriptive/process/reference sets. Raw lexical rows are contextual candidates, not automatically productive targets. U10-L01 grammar rows are mainly reference/noun-phrase infrastructure. The Stage-7 semantic reroute raises the U10-L01 raw total to 55 without creating an ability-category overload. Reopen/split if Stage 8 active-role assignment or Stage 7 briefs make any slot cognitively dense.
critic_decisions.U11: Retain provisionally. Word warnings are modest (23-26) and occur in source-informed argument where broad issue/evidence vocabulary is partly contextual/receptive. Do not force all rows into productive memorisation.
critic_decisions.U12: Retain provisionally. Report/review genre lessons naturally expose broader formal/content vocabulary; the 26-27 raw word rows remain role-pending and must be re-audited after semantic lock.

decision: Accept the exact Stage-7-reconciled raw-warning set as a provisional scheduling candidate without raising thresholds or changing the 13-unit/95-slot architecture. All 270 ability introductions remain at or below the existing per-lesson ability threshold. Any warning-set change, Stage-7 brief overload, or Stage-8 productive-role concentration reopens this decision. Owner human approval remains required.
